name: ESP32-C5

reserved.16-22: Wired to the flash chip and PSRAM. Using them crashes the board.

avoid.2: Strapping pin. Its level at reset helps set the boot mode; check the board's wiring before using it.
avoid.7: Strapping pin. Its level at reset helps set the boot mode; check the board's wiring before using it.
avoid.11-12: UART0 TX and RX. On boards with a USB-serial chip, these carry the link to Thingstudio.
avoid.13-14: Native USB D- and D+. On boards that use native USB for serial, using them cuts the link to Thingstudio.
avoid.25: Strapping pin. Its level at reset helps set the boot mode; check the board's wiring before using it.
avoid.27-28: Strapping pins. Their level at reset helps set the boot mode; check the board's wiring before using them.

notes: ESP32-C5 (single-core RISC-V, dual-band WiFi 6, Bluetooth LE 5). One SPI bus (1) and one I2C bus (0) for user code. ADC inputs: 1-6, all on ADC1, so WiFi doesn't block them. Images start at 0x2000, not 0.
